name: Inku
source:
A suspicious creature calling herself an angel who is a former culprit in which cormorants grew in deep red. 
It's about the size you usually get in your hands. 
The personality is lazy anyway, and it always makes me sleepy. I have no motivation anyway. 
Violent tone of voice that can not be thought of as an angel so much. Even if you think about it is a small devil.

she is also responsible for giving Shinku penis calling it gods blessing

[spoiler] Its later revealed that she is in fact a fallen angel [/spoiler]
